messages:
incident-bot: SEV2 — anomalous cross-region steering detected. us-west-2 latency spike (p95/p99) and increased errors. Traffic telemetry shows ~40% sudden shift to us-east-1 for region-pinned routes. Alerting oncall@channel and creating thread. src: routing-telemetry, probe-agg.

oncall-alex: ack. I’m booting up tools and pulling recent routing policy changes. Paging SRE.

sre-jordan: on it. seeing a spike in tail latency on west endpoints, concurrent with a config push ~12:34 UTC (route weight promotion).

netops-lee: I can confirm BGP/edge looks normal from provider side. No broad network flaps. Likely policy decision in routing controller.

infra-elaine: checking autoscaling and capacity in us-east-1 — healthy but some pods hitting CPU spikes where traffic landed. Not yet saturated.

eng-runtime-sam: any rollout IDs? I can check rollout history and revert the policy if needed.

oncall-alex: rollout id r-20260315-452 applied at 12:34 UTC. That promoted latency-based weighting with a new decay parameter.

eng-runtime-sam: pulling the policy. Looks like decay parameter incorrectly inverted — it promoted the lower sample count region instead of higher capacity region. That would explain traffic shift.

incident-bot: Related alerts: route-error-rate +45% (12:36), region-latency-spike-us-west2 (12:35).

netops-lee: recommend immediate mitigation: pin critical customer routes back to us-west-2 and rollback the r-20260315-452 rollout.

oncall-alex: executing rollback now. Command: 
```
redwoodctl rollout rollback --id r-20260315-452 --reason "latency-steering mispromote"
```

eng-runtime-sam: rollback acked by controller, starting gradual revert. I’m also issuing a targeted pin for VIPs to us-west-2: 
```
redwoodctl route pin --selector "vip:critical" --region us-west-2 --duration 30m --reason "hotfix"
```

infra-elaine: autoscaling responding; CPU on east-backed pods is trending down as traffic shifts back. No errors from infra side now.

support-maya: heads up — a subset of enterprise customers in EU reported elevated latencies during the shift. I’ve opened tickets and notified CS to prepare comms.

pm-lucy: thanks. Please collect affected customer list (tenant ids) and ETA for stable routing so we can update status page.

eng-runtime-sam: rollback finished at 12:42 UTC, policy state reverted. Routing telemetry shows gradual rebalancing back to west over ~3m.

oncall-alex: confirming p95/p99 in us-west-2 trending back to normal; error-rate dropping. Will keep pinned for 30m to ensure stability then unpin if safe.

netops-lee: can we add a temporary guard to prevent decay inversion on future promotions? Might be a config validation gap.

eng-runtime-sam: agreed. I’ll push a validation to the controller: require monotonicity check between sample-weight and weight assignment. Patch in progress.

incident-bot: Incident book: creating incident incident-20260315-5567894321, severity: SEV2, postmortem required.

oncall-alex: summary for status page: brief incident, routing policy mispromotion caused cross-region shift and customer-impacted latencies for ~8 minutes, corrective rollback applied.

support-maya: added affected tenant IDs to tickets and sent a proactive note to top 3 impacted customers.

pm-lucy: SRE/eng please capture timeline and RCA items. I’ll own customer comms after you confirm final list and ETA.

eng-runtime-sam: RCA notes: rollout automation bug inverted decay parameter; immediate mitigation: rollback + targeted pins. Next actions: hotfix validation + unit tests, canary config check, add telemetry alert for unexpected region weight deltas.

sre-jordan: oncall handoff at 13:00 UTC to night team. I’ll finish a short runbook for next oncall with commands used.

oncall-alex: handoff accepted. leaving live monitoring for 20m then handoff.

incident-bot: Handoff reminder scheduled at 13:00 UTC to channel. Incident remains open.

pm-lucy: filing post-incident checklist: patch controller, add config lint, update rollout runbook, customer follow-ups. Assigning owners in the doc.

support-maya: confirmed customers notified; no escalations pending.

eng-runtime-sam: will open PR for validation and add a regression test. Target merge by EOD.

sre-jordan: closing thread for now, will update incident doc with final timestamps and attach logs. If something reappears ping @oncall.

oncall-alex: thanks team. continuing to monitor until handoff. :thumbsup:
